I love my friends and still want to hangout with them, but The dad being around ALL THE TIME is too much. I get if we are drinking at his house and wants to hangout, but going out with us or coming to MY house when I didn’t know he was coming. Aita for asking my friend if his dad is going to be there before I agree to hangout with them?
